Data exfiltration using 7-zip and Rclone to cloud storage (OneDrive, Google Drive, Mega)
Lateral movement via RDP access and PsExec, WMI for ransomware deployment
Initial breach via QakBot (banking trojan spread by phishing with malicious Word docs) and public-facing RDP servers
Persistence via Run keys and scheduled tasks
Payload extraction from JPG or BMP image files using PowerShell
Impacted Systems: Corporate networks of businesses and local governments
Diebold Nixdorf ATM provider's corporate network
Attack Vector: Access via public-facing Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) servers
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes in text files dropped in every folder
Use of PowerShell scripts extracting ransomware binary from image files
Use of cloud storage services (OneDrive, Google Drive, Mega) for data exfiltration
Batch scripts downloaded from cloud storage repositories
Use of PsExec and WMI for lateral movement and ransomware deployment
